svg.title: Patchy contest — 016 / The unreachable field — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog of war, Patchy contest: 016 / The unreachable field, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Shaded relief with a soft, irregular fog edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Many pictograms lie draped on the ground beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: ONE FORM OF EACH FAMILY SHOWN / ALL LIE UNDER THE FOG
NO ONE IN THIS STORY CAN SEE THIS PAGE. THIS MAP DOES NOT UPDATE.
016.2–5 / OAI-BH, one conference talk; no independent review · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC RELIEF / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
